facts.text: Propagated safety-mode configuration through a Python service, build objects and wrapper generation to connect generated error-code signals to AXI/ACE-Lite and AHB testbench sidebands.
Integrated parity, hang and ECC model outputs with an existing UVM fault-injection interrupt interface, extending what the testbench could observe beyond ordinary traffic checking.
Adapted safety-mode payload checking to distinguish generated protection sidebands from ordinary user payload while retaining data comparisons.

Updated source/generated configuration collateral and simulator full-access selection for a fault-injection control flow. Repetition, transaction-count and phase settings define intended runs, not completed or passing campaigns; historical top-level bindings later changed.
